therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: suppression of chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: adult cancer patients receiving highly emetogenic chemotherapy (cisplatin or cyclophosphamide/doxorubicin) with standard antiemetic prophylaxis
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Proportion of patients with no nausea (0–120 hours after chemotherapy)

subgroup_findings: No nausea 0–24 h: olanzapine 73.8% vs placebo 45.3%
No nausea 25–120 h: olanzapine 42.4% vs placebo 25.4%
No nausea 0–120 h: olanzapine 37.3% vs placebo 21.9%
Complete response 0–24 h: olanzapine 85.7% vs placebo 64.6%
Complete response 25–120 h: olanzapine 66.9% vs placebo 52.4%
Complete response 0–120 h: olanzapine 63.6% vs placebo 40.6%
Median nausea scores (VAS 0–10) lower in olanzapine arm on Days 2–6 (median 0 vs 1)
Undesired sedation higher in olanzapine arm on Day 2 (mean 2.3 vs 1.2)
Rescue medication use lower in olanzapine arm across Days 2–6
safety_signals: Undesired sedation was higher in the olanzapine arm on Day 2 (mean 2.3 vs 1.2) but converged by Days 3–6
Appetite increase slightly higher in olanzapine arm on Days 4–6
Serious adverse events reported in olanzapine arm: neutrophil count decreased (2/188), white blood cell decreased (1/188), thromboembolic event (1/188)

modulation_entries.hypothesis: Olanzapine's broad receptor antagonism (D2, 5-HT2A, H1, muscarinic) complements 5-HT3 blockade by ondansetron/granisetron/palonosetron, providing additive suppression of nausea and vomiting through complementary neurotransmitter pathways
modulation_entries.citation: No nausea 0–120 h: olanzapine arm 37.3% vs placebo arm 21.9%; complete response 0–120 h: olanzapine 63.6% vs placebo 40.6%

modulation_entries.hypothesis: Olanzapine's dopaminergic and serotonergic antagonism adds complementary antiemetic coverage beyond NK1 receptor blockade by aprepitant/fosaprepitant, particularly in the delayed phase
modulation_entries.citation: No nausea 25–120 h: olanzapine 42.4% vs placebo 25.4%; complete response 25–120 h: olanzapine 66.9% vs placebo 52.4%
